title: Continuous glucose monitoring versus self-monitoring of blood glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
abstract: Methods: 240 adults with type 2 diabetes were randomized to CGM or SMBG for 26 weeks. The primary outcome was change in HbA1c. Results: HbA1c decreased by 0.9% in the CGM group versus 0.4% in the SMBG group.

title: Flash glucose monitoring in adolescents with type 1 diabetes: a randomized trial
abstract: We randomized 150 adolescents with type 1 diabetes to flash glucose monitoring or usual care for 24 weeks and measured HbA1c and time in range.

title: Continuous glucose monitoring in type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: We systematically reviewed randomized trials of CGM in type 2 diabetes and pooled HbA1c outcomes across 12 studies.

title: Real-time continuous glucose monitoring in adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial with prespecified subgroup analyses
abstract: We randomized 180 adults with type 1 (n=90) or type 2 (n=90) diabetes to real-time CGM or SMBG. Overall HbA1c fell by 0.5%. In the prespecified subgroup analysis in type 2 diabetes showed HbA1c reduction of 0.6% with CGM versus SMBG.
_note: 虚构：混合人群，用于演示 D1 分歧

title: Feasibility of a factory-calibrated continuous glucose monitoring system in type 2 diabetes: a pilot study
abstract: Twenty adults with type 2 diabetes used a factory-calibrated CGM for 12 weeks. The primary outcome was device wearability and sensor accuracy (MARD); glycemic outcomes including HbA1c were not assessed in this pilot.

title: 持续葡萄糖监测对2型糖尿病患者血糖控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
abstract: 目的：评价持续葡萄糖监测对成人2型糖尿病患者糖化血红蛋白的影响。方法：120例患者随机分为监测组与对照组，随访24周。
